artworks.title: The Burial (Begräbnis)
artworks.medium: color linocut on japan paper
artworks.description: The image consists of wavy, elongated lines and shapes forming an abstract depiction of a procession moving through a valley. Small, dark shapes with highlights of red and blue suggest figures marching or walking. Abstract formations resembling hills are on both sides, with black lines suggesting landscape contours. In the distance, blocky, red forms could be interpreted as buildings. The dark background enhances the abstract nature of the image.

artworks.title: Mädchen am Fenster (Girl by the Window)
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting at a table. The person is seated and has a somber expression with dark, deep-set eyes and a relatively neutral mouth. They have a short bob hairstyle with dark and lighter shades. The person is wearing a dark green jacket over a light blue shirt, with a yellow ribbon tied at the neck. The background is reddish with abstract textures. There is a window on the right with blue, yellow, and white hues. On the table is a rectangular object with muted shades of beige and pink.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in Front of Stairs (Selbst vor Treppe)
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up, facing forward with a direct gaze. Their facial features are stylized with bold colors, including large green eyes. The person has short, parted hair with reflective highlights suggesting a blonde shade. They wear a blue garment with a bow around the neck and a hint of a patterned shirt collar underneath. The background includes a light-painted wall, a staircase visible through an open doorway on the left, and a tall window with a crossbar on the right. The composition is colorful and expressive.

artworks.title: Landscape with Man Pushing a Cart
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with undulating terrain seen from a slightly downward angle. The horizon is not distinct, and there are trees and buildings in the distance. Two figures are visible in the foreground; one is pushing a wheelbarrow uphill under a large tree. The tree is detailed with dense foliage and intricate cross-hatching. Smaller trees and bushes lead the eye further into the image where more trees and a structure can be seen. The color scheme is monochromatic using sepia and black shades to highlight contrast and detail, giving the scene a timeless quality.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape with a Satyr Family
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 28.1 × 35.9 cm (11 1/16 × 14 1/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the composition, partly obscured by tall trees. The intricate brushwork captures the natural textures of the trees and vegetation with fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic, leaning towards a sepia tone. There are two figures with a goat carrying a basket, surrounded by plants and a rocky outcrop. In the background, there are vast trees and structures or ruins partially hidden among them, bathed in gentle light.

artworks.title: Mending the Nets
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette, worked over in graphite and white heightening on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with figures engaged in agricultural work. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a high horizon line, an expansive sky dominating the upper portion of the image, loose brushstrokes or etching lines creating texture, and a limited sepia and black color palette. Multiple figures are shown in the foreground and background, with details becoming less distinct as they move further away.

artworks.title: Mending the Nets
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image features a scene with figures seated on the ground in a flat landscape that extends into the distance. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky filled with textured clouds. The monochromatic palette consists of black and gray shades, and loose brushstrokes suggest movement. The figures, mostly women, are engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Landscape with Broken Tree
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rough terrain, trees, paths, and two resting figures near a winding path. The composition leads towards an open sky in the upper right corner. The etching uses detailed line work and shading to depict the foliage and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia and brown tones to create contrast and depth. Lighter tones show light filtering through the canopy, while darker areas suggest dense landscapes.

artworks.title: Mercury Abducting Psyche
artworks.artist: Michael Philip I, after Jan Muller
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink, brown and grey wash heightened with white
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two mythological figures embracing in a dynamic pose. The male figure appears to be lifting the female figure, both displaying muscular forms. The male figure wears a helmet with wings, resembling Mercury or Hermes. Both figures are nude, with the male figure sporting a winged sandal. The sculpture is monochrome, likely marble, with intricate anatomical detailing. The figures stand on a pedestal above the viewer.

artworks.title: The Mill at the Great Oaks
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a riverside scene with a low horizon and dense trees in the background. The brushstrokes are intricate, creating detail in the environment. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. There is water reflecting the scene, a wooden structure among trees on the left, and a person with horses on the right. The canopy above is detailed with varying tones.

artworks.title: The Virgin Mary Taking Leave of Christ
artworks.medium: etching (iron), plate bitten twice, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.2 x 22 cm (11 1/2 x 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around an infant in an architectural setting. The image shows individuals in robes surrounding an infant held by a central figure. In the background, an architectural archway frames the scene. Details include fabric folds, hair, and facial expressions. The engraving technique features fine lines and intricate detail, creating contrast and depth in the characters and architecture. A dog is also present at the feet of the figures.

artworks.title: The Circus
artworks.medium: platinum print
artworks.creditLine: The Sarah and William L Walton Fund
artworks.description: This is a grayscale photograph of an acrobat in mid-leap above a white horse inside a circus tent. The horse stands inside a ring, appearing to walk around the edge. It is turned slightly to the right, its head down. The acrobat floats above the horse, her arms extended out to either side and her legs bent. She is wearing a costume that looks like a dress with puffed sleeves and a tutu-like skirt. On the left, a man stands on the edge of the ring next to the horse, looking towards the acrobat. The man is wearing a black jacket and black trousers. Both the acrobat and the man are blurred, and we can't see their facial features. Behind the performance, a similarly blurred audience can be seen sitting in rows, looking towards the performance. Above and behind them are the walls of the tent, which include ropes and a small decorative banner. Light seems to filter in through the side of the tent.

artworks.title: Fremont's Peak in the Wind River Gorge, Wyoming
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged landscape with rocky terrain and greenery. A seated figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat is visible on the rocks. In the background, there is a calm lake reflecting the scenery and craggy mountains with snow patches under an overcast sky. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a timeless quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.artist: Joseph Sebastian Klauber, Johann Baptist Klauber, after Johann Wolfgang Baumgartner
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand-coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a scene with detailed classical architecture and horticultural elements. A pavilion with verdant growth and statues is on the left, while figures engage in gardening. On the right, a worker climbs a structure covered in golden elements and vegetation. The landscape features a formal garden with paths, trees, and a distant classical building. The sky has dramatic clouds, celestial figures, and cherubs. The color palette includes earthy tones, pastels, and rich golden and green hues. The brushwork is precise, with fine lines in the clouds and architecture.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.artist: Joseph Sebastian Klauber, Johann Baptist Klauber, after Johann Wolfgang Baumgartner
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand-coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy scene with various figures and activities. The landscape shows agricultural fields, hills, and a village in the distance. Celestial figures surrounded by zodiac symbols hover above. The painting shows detailed brushstrokes and engravings capturing the movement and expressions of the figures. The color palette includes earth tones along with bright reds and blues in the clothing. The artwork combines elements of everyday life with mythology.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.artist: Joseph Sebastian Klauber, Johann Baptist Klauber, after Johann Wolfgang Baumgartner
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with extensive hand-coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the image, showing a landscape on the right with mountains and a vineyard. On the left, there are pillars and trees with detailed foliage. The style features controlled brushstrokes emphasizing textures and forms. The color palette includes natural greens and browns in the landscape, while figures wear reds, blues, and oranges. In the sky, mythological figures are painted with clouds below them. The image combines classical architecture, nature, and human activity in a detailed and colorful composition.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.artist: Joseph Sebastian Klauber, Johann Baptist Klauber, after Johann Wolfgang Baumgartner
artworks.medium: complete set of four; etching and engraving, hand-colored on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a Biblical scene set within a city. The image depicts a gathering of people in the foreground surrounded by architectural elements and twisted, ornate frames. It includes various human figures gathered together in a narrative moment. Above, a group of figures sits on clouds, gazing down upon the scene below. The ornate frames around the painting feature detailed carvings of foliage and fantastical designs. Background structures exhibit classic architectural styles. The painting symbolizes a mixture of human and divine interactions.

artworks.title: The Lamentation (STATIO XIII)
artworks.medium: pen and brush in black and grey wash with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central reclining figure near a cross. The scene is rendered in shades of grey and blue, with delicate line work and shading that suggests a somber atmosphere. Various figures are interacting with the central figure, who appears to have been recently lowered from a cross, hinted at by the ladders and cross structures in the background. The use of space and composition directs the viewer's eye to the central action. The setting includes a background which suggests a city or fortress wall with towers.

artworks.title: Anne-Dorothée, Duchesse de Courlande
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with the focus on the head and torso. The individual is facing slightly to the left, looking towards the viewer. The person has delicate facial features and curly hair styled with a ribbon or headband. They are wearing a garment with an intricate design, featuring a V-neck and a buckle detail at the waist. The portrait is enclosed in a circular frame on a plain background.

artworks.title: Eine Mutter
artworks.medium: etching on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Marion Deshmukh
artworks.description: This image depicts a dockside scene with individuals on a balcony and a boat at a pier. The setting shows a gathering on an elevated structure connected to the water by a stairway. Large windows above the figures reveal architectural details. A person is seated on the boat near the water. The background includes additional buildings, one marked "DEUCHE KUNST." Shadows and reflections enhance the scene, and the style resembles 19th-century European realist works with precise line work.

artworks.title: Blind Homer
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste-Raphael-Urbain Massard, after Baron François Gerard
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state before engraving]
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures on rocky terrain near a body of water. The larger figure has curly hair, a beard, a draped garment, sandals, and a musical instrument slung over his shoulder. The smaller figure is a young boy with curly hair, wearing a short tunic. They are in a dramatic natural setting with a cloudy sky and the sea in the background.

artworks.title: Leopold Dick
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.7 x 15.7 cm (8 15/16 x 6 3/16 in.) (cut to platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is positioned in a slightly turned stance, with their head facing forward. The facial features include prominent eyes, a broad nose, and a full beard. The hair is curly and falls to the side of the face, emerging from under a large fabric hat. The clothing is ornate and detailed, featuring a richly textured and patterned fabric with elaborate designs on the sleeves and body. The person is holding a scroll in their right hand. Surrounding the individual is a text in a classical style, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: La Drague Dieppe (A Dredger in Dieppe Harbor by Moonlight)
artworks.medium: color etching and aquatint in blue and black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in the Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront view at dusk or dawn, overlooking the water towards the pier and city. The horizon is low in the image, just below the line of the pier and silhouetted cranes. The artwork style appears to use etching techniques with sharp lines and deep shadows. The color palette consists of dark tones, primarily blues and grays. The water reflects the dim light of a hidden or setting sun. There is a close structure resembling a dredger with a large wheel.

artworks.title: Christ as Man of Sorrows
artworks.artist: Antoine Coypel, finished in engraving by Charles Simonneau
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body. His head is tilted back, looking upwards with partially closed eyes. He has a beard, mustache, long wavy hair falling past his shoulders, and a crown of thorns on his head. The man wears a loose garment, crosses his hands over his chest, and holds a staff or rod. He has a thick rope around his neck and wrist. The background is dark, and there is a decorative label with text and a crest with a serpent emblem at the bottom.
